name: Fog Town
author: Krypt (GameBanana)
attribution: Converted from the map by Krypt (https://gamebanana.com/mods/127180, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 as listed there). The whole run, shaft and lower floor included; the water pits and ladders became plank floors, and the cage of the activators beside the start was dropped for a seat at the shaft. Geometry only: boxes and traps rebuilt from the map's brushes and entities, none of the author's textures, models or sounds. Shipped on the strength of credit and removal on request: tell the repository owner and the map is taken out.
blurb: A foggy town of traps: drop down the shaft and run the lower floor, the activator working axes, lasers and falling floors behind you.
